findings.summary: Panel declared aria-modal="true" while implementing no focus containment and leaving header/footer in the tab order — modality claimed but not built. Attribute removed, role="dialog" kept; e2e now asserts its absence (e2e/the-le.spec.ts:72). Frozen test contract amended in clarifications.md and FR-201 of both functional specs — recorded, not silently loosened.

Escape collided with language-selector.tsx's own document-level keydown, so closing the language dropdown also dismissed the panel and navigated away. Guarded with event.defaultPrevented (stopPropagation cannot separate two listeners on the same node).

Doc-comment block insisted the caption was ROOT FUTHER and must never be corrected — the exact reasoning a MoMorph re-read overturned, contradicting the shipped seed. Rewritten to record itemName (layer name) vs character (rendered text), keeping the verbatim-transcription rule that still binds for the 10–20 en dash.

Shipped spec still asserted assumption A1 (window.history.length is a good enough signal) after phase 07 measured the opposite. Rewritten to BÁC BỎ with the measured about:blank evidence and the navigation.canGoBack resolution; A2 likewise.

Generated route inventory still recorded /standards as ComingSoon under F002 and counted five placeholders. Corrected to ROUTE007/F007 with a StandardsPage handler; count corrected to the three real remaining importers. doc-writer also found and fixed the same class of drift on /profile left over from F006.

useRulesDismiss is instantiated twice with no shared latch, so two fast Escape presses could pop two history entries. Low impact, no reported symptom; a module-level dismissing flag cleared on popstate would close it.

Two selects run per request for 13 rows that only change by migration. Matches the house pattern (no caching layer anywhere in lib/kudos or lib/profile) and the page is already dynamic via cookies(); the obvious first lever if /standards ever takes traffic.

Supabase's alter default privileges grants anon the full DML set incl. TRUNCATE on every public table; RLS is what denies the writes, and TRUNCATE sits outside RLS. Pre-existing repo-wide (reproduced on F004's board_stats), unreachable via PostgREST which never emits TRUNCATE. Deliberately not patched as a one-table special case — the right shape is a repo-wide migration.

Full suite is inconclusive, not green: 70 passed / 26 failed / 94 did not run, every failure a 30s auth.setup.ts timeout on cold next dev with no assertion diff. Proven NOT an F007 regression (same specs fail identically in isolation, incl. smoke.spec.ts which predates the feature), but 94 tests are unverified. Needs its own harness commission; the timeout was NOT widened to hide it.

Empty-table and query-error branches have no committed test — the repo has no unit-test runner and adding one was out of scope. Both were traced by hand and exercised via throwaway stub-client probes.
